files.action: one-line edit: append ':/data/local/tmp/asx/libopensles_android_compat.so' to export LD_PRELOAD (line 33)

change.why_preload_not_anchor: RouteB libart 78e34445 has a single ANCHOR (android-native ns) and no NEXT_ANCHOR; anchoring libttmplayer would move it into the android-native namespace (namespace change, libc++ ordering risk). LD_PRELOAD keeps libttmplayer in namespace 0 and gives the same ordering guarantee the player_anchor provided (compat before player). Same mechanism already used by RouteB for libwebview_bionic_shim/libttcrypto.
